name: find-or-create-practitioner-specific-careteam
title: Find or create a Practitioner-specific CareTeam
description:
The operation returns the Practitioner-specific CareTeam for the given Practitioner and authorisation. 
A Practitioner-specific CareTeam is found by the given qualification. When no such CareTeam exists, a new one is created. 
The Practitioner must have an active qualification with the given authorisation. 
An OperationOutcome with an explicit error is returned in case the Practitioner is not found, in case the Practitioner has no active qualification with the given authorisation, in case the CareTeam found is inactive or its period has ended, or in case several CareTeams are found for the authorisation.

parameter.name: qualification
parameter.documentation: Mandatory identifier (system and value) of the Practitioner's authorisation qualification

parameter.name: return
parameter.documentation: The Practitioner-specific CareTeam for the given authorisation. When none exists, it is created.
